 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Game #8 is today and it is in a stadium that many of us Spartan fans have some wonderful memories of. Unfortunately, this matchup is not an earned bowl game at the end of a highly accomplished MSU season. Rather, our 2-5 squad is playing conference foe UCLA and their perfect 6-0 record. The Bruins have been playing at a high level while MSU is dealing with a high level of injuries .
 The game starts at 3:30 PM ET and is airing on CBS. It's Saturday; let's get rowdy!
